title: Perturbation Boundaries of Spatial-Code Activity and Stability
scientific_scope: All frozen unit-session activity and spatial metrics plus tracked-unit repeated- and new-environment stability summaries.
analysis_unit: One animal with its units and sessions, or one tracked unit within an animal; units from one animal are nested observations.
missingness: No curator-imposed row deletion, random subsampling, or imputation is applied within the frozen task boundary.
license_boundary: The selected CC BY source-data measurements are bundled with animal, unit, and experimental identities anonymized.
warnings: The number of animals is limited; unit counts do not increase the independent animal sample size.
The task provides summary metrics rather than raw spike trains and cannot reconstruct every spatial field definition.
source_coverage_statement: The bundled files are complete within the scientific_scope declared for this task. This does not assert that every variable, record, or file in the upstream scientific source is included.
